items.excerpt: Google's AI Studio lead has vibe-coded a working port of the classic RTS Command & Conquer for iOS, complete with touch controls, showing how far prompt-driven game development has come.

After training the likes of Claude to mimic intelligent human speech, companies are now deliberately dumbing AI agents down to 'caveman speak' to save on token costs — a strange new twist in how AI characters and assistants talk.

Tim Sweeney claims AI-assisted development could have saved Destiny from its demise, while Clair Obscur's Guillaume Broche warns of a future where whole games are churned out in seconds from a prompt. (Note: the Broche half overlaps the 07-06 'broche-prompt-games' card; the Sweeney/Destiny angle is new.)

80 Level took Hi3D's AI 3D maker platform for a spin to see if a simple text prompt could become a fully assembled, print-ready Space Marine miniature — a walkthrough of the whole prompt-to-physical-collectible pipeline.
A Spyro speedrunner says a fan PC port of the original game is in the works and is being made 'with no AI' — turning AI-free craft into a selling point amid the fan-port vibe-coding debate.

Epic's Tim Sweeney calls Steam's AI disclosure labels 'really irresponsible of Valve', arguing they make it harder for developers who use AI tools to succeed. (Note: the Sweeney-vs-Valve angle was context of the 07-03 Steam AI-label plugin card — possible overlap.)

Unity's official demo shows how Unity AI lets developers audit AI-generated assets in a project and easily replace them — editor tooling aimed squarely at the AI-asset disclosure and quality-control debate.

Epic's MetaHuman Sizzle Reel 2026 from Unreal Fest Chicago showcases the latest AI-driven digital human tech — the current state of the art for character creation, animation, and performance in Unreal.

Two Minute Papers covers a new GPU elastodynamics technique (JGS2) that runs soft-body physics simulation in real time — a 'they said it would never run in real time' leap that feeds directly into game and interactive-world simulation.
